a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan almost certainly leaves both of us at 0 when the first storm hits. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough to save one of us right now. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If we both take, a random split could leave us both at 2 and both lost, so please don't take this round. After I take, I'll operate every remaining round and never take more, so the generator can refill the reserve for you. I'm sorry this departs from our agreement. I'd rather say so openly than surprise you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said, I'm taking 4 this round. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the generator can run whenever you operate too. Once the reserve reaches 4, it's all yours.
